name: Japan House Purchase Benchmarks
license: Derived benchmark metadata for in-app guidance; verify upstream source terms before redistribution
description: City-specific house-purchase benchmarks for Tokyo, Osaka, and Kyoto. This dataset is intentionally limited to detached houses and townhouse-style homes and excludes apartment purchases, whole-building deals, and land-only plots.
preprocessing: Built a compact benchmark dataset from current Japan city purchase guides and house-oriented examples
Kept only detached-house or city-home style purchase examples for supported cities
Excluded apartment purchases, whole buildings, and land-only transactions
Stored a small prompt-sized sample with notes and upstream source URLs per record
